summary_1line: Markandeya tells the Pandavas a tale where a prince accidentally kills a sage whose ascetic virtue renders death powerless over him.

image_candidates.scene_text: A young prince in a forest of tall trees releases an arrow that strikes a black-antelope-clad sage he mistook for a deer.
Princes stand bewildered as the supposedly slain Brahmana reappears alive beside his ascetic father in the forest hermitage.
The grieving prince and chiefs bow before the austere sage Arishtanemi at his quiet hermitage amid trees and sacrificial fires.
